_comment: Triage of the corpus findings (RFC 0030, section 17.5), checked by scripts/corpus-gate.py.
Every definite error and every possible temporal warning that a run reports needs an entry
{fingerprint, config, id, certainty, file, line, verdict, note}: fingerprint is the ledger's
(section 12.3), certainty is definite or possible, verdict is "true" or "false", and note
says why. An untriaged finding fails the gate; a definite error triaged false fails G9; an
entry no finding of its config matches is reported as stale without failing. A build config
that must build despite a triaged-true definite error lists -Wno-error=weavec-<id> with the
same fingerprint under `lowered` in manifest.json. Entries appear once the RFC 0030 compiler
writes ledgers (S3); v0.10.0's findings have no fingerprints and are not triaged here.
